segments.snp5.6:1.1: “Pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ,(iccāyasmā dhotako)
segments.snp5.6:3.3: Taṃ taṃ namassāmi samantacakkhu, pamuñca maṃ sakka kathaṃkathāhi”.
segments.snp5.6:4.1: “Nāhaṃ sahissāmi [samissāmi (syā.), gamissāmi (sī.), samīhāmi (pī.)] pamocanāya, kathaṃkathiṃ dhotaka kañci loke;
segments.snp5.6:4.3: Dhammañca seṭṭhaṃ abhijānamāno [ājānamāno (sī. syā. pī.)], evaṃ tuvaṃ oghamimaṃ taresi”.
segments.snp5.6:5.3: Yathāhaṃ ākāsova abyāpajjamāno, idheva santo asito careyyaṃ”.
segments.snp5.6:6.1: “Kittayissāmi te santiṃ,(dhotakāti bhagavā) diṭṭhe dhamme anītihaṃ;
segments.snp5.6:6.4: Yaṃ viditvā sato caraṃ, tare loke visattikaṃ”.
segments.snp5.6:7.3: Yaṃ viditvā sato caraṃ, tare loke visattikaṃ”.
segments.snp5.6:8.4: Etaṃ viditvā saṅgoti loke, bhavābhavāya mākāsi taṇhan”ti.

lines: Sikkhe nibbānamattanoti attano rāgādīnaṃ nibbānatthāya adhisīlādīni sikkheyya.
